answer: We establish Sybil resistance by binding dynamic opportunity-cost staking collateral to zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs and subgame-perfect slashing matrices. Adversarial identity multiplication drives payoffs to a critical nadir, as mirror nodes fail synchronized delay challenges and trigger automated liquidations across a lotus topology of penalty pools. Because capital costs strictly exceed maximum extractable value, identity multiplication yields negative expected utility, establishing honest participation as the unique Nash equilibrium.
